programs.description: Three unemployed lads help a politician, trusting him to offer them jobs after he wins. However, when he betrays them, they devise a clever plan to hold him accountable.
Raja, a dancer, vows to take revenge on a rich man for killing his father. He falls in love with Radha, but little does he know that she is the daughter of the man who killed his father.
Urmila, in her quest for love, faces various personal struggles and emotional challenges. However, while navigating the complexities of her relationships, she embarks on a journey of self-discovery.
An intelligent girl strives to overcome multiple challenges in life in order to fulfil her aspirations and become a doctor.
